description: This file contains unit tests for serialization round-trip validation of various data types including records, enums, and inherited generics within an Orleans-based distributed system. It uses Xunit for testing and interacts with grain interfaces to perform asynchronous validation of serialization correctness.

classes.name: RoundTripSerializerTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies serialization and deserialization of various data types in an Orleans cluster environment.

methods.name: Serialize_TestMethodResultRecord
methods.description: Tests serialization of a record type returned from a grain method.

methods.name: Serialize_TestMethodResultEnum
methods.description: Tests serialization of an enum type returned from a grain method.

methods.name: Serialize_TestMethodResultWithInheritedClosedGeneric
methods.description: Tests serialization of a generic object returned from a grain method.
